Illustrate an investment portfolio: a tidy folder open on a desk containing three simple unlabelled charts, a diversified pie chart, a bar chart and a gently rising line chart, with a few small neutral coins beside it. The charts are the main subject, not a wallet. Friendly clear children's educational illustration, crisp shapes, softly shaded colors, warm white background, large centered subject readable at 160 pixels. No words, letters, numbers, labels, watermark or brand names.
